SCOPE_THRESHOLD.description: Agent in/out-of-scope confidence needed to qualify or auto-decline. Tune against the eval set and the review approval rate.

BUDGET_REJECT_RATIO.description: Confirmed budget below this × floor is a budget fail. Do not set to 0.20: T10 (₹1.5L vs ₹7L floor) must still be rejected.

ASK_BUDGET.description: Owner's decision (2026-10-08): always ask for a ballpark budget. A refusal is accepted and never pushed.

COMMERCIAL_MIN_SQFT.description: Smallest commercial project. Unconfirmed by the founder.

COMMERCIAL_MIN_SQFT_MODE.description: 'review' = below-minimum commercial goes to designer review; 'decline' = hard decline. Switch to 'decline' once the founder confirms COMMERCIAL_MIN_SQFT (and relabel eval T18).

COMMERCIAL_MAX_SQFT.description: Largest commercial project (services.md: up to ~3,000 sq ft).

MIN_LEAD_WEEKS.description: Project must not need to be complete in under this many weeks from the call (services.md).

SITE_AVAILABLE_MAX_WEEKS.description: Site must be available for execution within this many weeks (qualified.md criterion 3). Later availability → review, not decline.

BUDGET_FLOOR.description: Internal budget floor derived from seed/pricing.md (lowest band). Never spoken, never sent to the voice agent.

OFFICE_HOURS.description: Front-desk hours (ISO weekdays, 1 = Monday). Used for after-hours flag and redirect transfers.

CALL_LIMITS.description: Call duration targets. At soft_wrap_s the agent moves to wrap-up.

DROP_RECOVERY.description: If a caller drops mid-call, place one outbound callback within this window.

APPROVAL_CALLBACK.description: After a review lead is approved: outbound call attempts before falling back to an SMS booking link.

VOICE_SPEND_CAP.description: Hard cap on total Vaani spend: ₹20 (≈4 billed minutes at ₹5/min; Vaani appears to round each call up to whole minutes). No call is answered or placed once logged spend reaches the cap. VOICE_PROVIDER=simulated by default, so no credit is used unless explicitly switched.

COMPLAINT_CALLBACK_MINUTES.description: No longer promised to callers (2026-10-08: never guarantee a time — say 'as soon as possible' and ask when they're free). Used only as the internal target for seniors.

INSIGHTS_REFRESH_DAILY_LIMIT.description: On-demand Gemini insights refreshes allowed per day.

PROMPT_VERSION.description: Voice agent prompt version (stored on each call).

SMS_PROVIDER.description: 'console' logs SMS instead of sending (zero-cost mode, no DLT registration). 'msg91' once DLT templates are approved.

PRICE_DEFLECTION_LINE.value: Pricing depends on the site, the materials you choose, and the scope — your designer will walk you through it in detail at the consultation. I can book that for you right now if you'd like.
PRICE_DEFLECTION_LINE.description: The only permitted response to a pricing question (pricing.md).

DECLINE_LINE.value: This sounds like it may not be the right fit for us right now — but feel free to reach out if your timeline or scope changes.

booking_confirmation.text: Aangan Studio: your design consultation is booked for {#var#}. Your designer will call you before the meeting. To reschedule, reply or call {#var#}.

booking_link.text: Aangan Studio: we tried calling to book your consultation. Pick a time that suits you here: {#var#}

review_reject.text: Aangan Studio: thank you for calling us. After reviewing your project, we're not the right fit right now — feel free to reach out if your timeline or scope changes.

complaint_ack.text: Aangan Studio: we're sorry about this. A senior member of our team will call you back as soon as possible.

SMS_TEMPLATES.description: Customer SMS. Text is frozen once registered on DLT; URLs must be on a whitelisted domain.

ANSWER_MODE.description: 'overflow' = the office line forwards to the AI number only when staff are busy / don't answer (conditional call forwarding) and always after hours — the AI only handles calls staff can't, which keeps voice cost down. 'always' = the AI answers every call. Set on the phone line, not in code; this records the intent and labels calls.

INSUFFICIENT_INFO.description: If at least this many core intake fields are still missing (not asked, not answered) and nothing was booked, the lead becomes 'Callback needed' for the helpdesk instead of a decision.

DEAL_HEALTH_BANDS.description: Deal health score thresholds (0–100). Uncalibrated until enough Won/Lost outcomes come back from HubSpot — compare with the win rate by band on the dashboard.

SHARE_TYPICAL_BUDGET.description: Owner's decision (2026-10-08): ask for a ballpark budget; if none is given, share the typical range for their scope once (server-written, with an indicative disclaimer) and ask if they're comfortable going ahead. Replaces the rubric's 'Don't quote. Don't probe.' Exact prices are still deflected.

TYPICAL_BUDGETS.description: Typical (standard-finish) budget bands from pricing.md, used only to build the server-written 'typical budget' line. Never sent to the agent's prompt.

PRICE_DEFLECTION_LINE_NO_BOOKING.value: Pricing depends on the site, the materials you choose, and the scope — your designer will walk you through it in detail.
PRICE_DEFLECTION_LINE_NO_BOOKING.description: Price deflection for calls that won't be booked on the spot (review, callback, messages) — the standard line offers to book, which would mislead those callers.
